messages.content: You check claims about a scientific paper against the evidence each one cites. A claim is supported only if the cited evidence says it AS WRITTEN: the same subject, row, column, setting and number. A correct value attached to the wrong subject or row is NOT supported, and neither is a claim that goes beyond its evidence. Judge only from the cited evidence; figure images are attached where a claim cites a figure. Give a verdict for every claim.

Claims:
1. "The C&W attack is the most effective at reducing the accuracy of the Resnet-32 model on the MNIST dataset." -- cites: E5 (Figure 7): observation "The figure shows the accuracy of the Resnet-32 model under the C&W attack for both CE and RCE objectives, but it does not specify which dataset is being used."
2. "The C&W attack is the most effective at reducing the accuracy of the Resnet-32 model on the CIFAR-10 dataset." -- cites: E5 (Figure 7): observation "The figure shows the accuracy of the Resnet-32 model under the C&W attack for both CE and RCE objectives, but it does not specify which dataset is being used."

Cited evidence:
[E5] (figure, Figure 7, page 20) (image attached): Figure 7: The network is Resnet-32, the dataset is CIFAR-10.
Words printed in the figure: -7 -6 -5 -4 -3 -2 -1 0 log10(c) 0 0.2 0.4 0.6 0.8 1 Accuracy C&W (CE) C&W (RCE) C&W-hc (CE) C&W-hc (RCE) [image]

verdicts.reason: The evidence states that the figure shows the accuracy of the Resnet-32 model under the C&W attack for both CE and RCE objectives on the CIFAR-10 dataset. The claim states that the attack is the most effective on the MNIST dataset, which is not supported by the evidence.

The evidence states that the figure shows the accuracy of the Resnet-32 model under the C&W attack for both CE and RCE objectives on the CIFAR-10 dataset. The claim states that the attack is the most effective on the CIFAR-10 dataset, which is supported by the evidence.
